reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that visualizes session token usage by cache-read, uncached-input, and output segments using existing tokenUsage data.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中以分段用量条展示会话的缓存输入、未缓存输入和输出 token 数量。
summaries.en: Displays a session’s cache-read, uncached-input, and output token counts as a segmented usage bar in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: Displays session token usage in a segmented UI bar
Reads existing token usage projections from the host application
Formats and presents cache-read, uncached-input, and output token counts
